notes: Reference values for calibration harness. Replace with measured commercial-simulator values when available. Re-baselined 2026-08-27 (4th pass). Every drift from the 3rd-pass (2026-08-14) values was attributed by bisect to a deliberate physics correction; none was an unexplained regression. (a) 5f2a4f7 'CFL-adaptive thermal timestep with recalescence cap' caps recalescence at T_sol so a voxel that crosses below solidus on a coarse step is not re-heated into the mushy zone as a permanent hot lump. That moved baseline cast_shrinkage_mean 0.069935 -> 0.083056, baseline side_solidification_time_mean 199.8 -> 163.68, chill side_solidification_time_mean 85.132 -> 74.904, and dual_riser cast_porosity_mean 0.050078 -> 0.0713. (b) 9049ae0 'Fix false shrinkage/porosity risk on chill faces' moved chill_block side_porosity_mean 0.033671 -> 0.017029 (-52%) and chill_block cast_shrinkage_mean 0.034 -> 0.025197, which is precisely that commit's stated purpose. Targets below are the current measured values; tolerances cover run-to-run variance. CORRECTION to the 3rd-pass note: the 'trimesh SIGTRAP flake in core/voxel_mesh.py' was neither trimesh, nor voxel_mesh, nor a flake. It was a deterministic out-of-bounds write in core/feeding_path.py trace_paths_from_risers_batch, which re-pushed already-queued nodes onto a fixed-capacity (n_voxels) frontier on every distance relaxation; under @jit(nopython=True) that unchecked write corrupted the heap and surfaced later as SIGTRAP/SIGSEGV inside libsystem_malloc during unrelated numpy allocation. Fixed 2026-08-27 by relaxing in place instead of re-inserting. Verified result-neutral: dual_riser cast_porosity_mean is 0.072525 both before and after the fix. Re-baselined 2026-10-05 (5th pass) for the gravity-drained riser pipe (physics/riser_pipe.py), which replaced a fixed geometric pipe template. (a) dual_riser cast_shrinkage_mean 0.018729 -> 0.035765: the two 1 in cube risers freeze at 290 s against the casting's 292 s, so the volume balance correctly sends 0.30 in^3 of pipe into the casting; the template had hidden the undersized feeders. (b) riser_post post_porosity_to_riser_ratio 0.466395 -> 0.25836: the pipe stays 2 in above the riser base and the post carries none of it; riser porosity rises because the pipe is now an open cavity.
